limitations: Author notebook cells 6 and 8 use the selected LFP/graphite half-cell pair for eleven full-cell configurations in the same laboratory study. Shared MTI electrode family, not an identified commercial model or proven identical harvested specimen.
Finite-current pseudo-OCP includes polarization and branch hysteresis; not equilibrium OCP.
Reference chemistry and numerical temperature not verified; Li/Li+ is not asserted. PyBaMM adaptation is blocked until reference evidence is curated.
Relative branch throughput requires independently justified stoichiometry endpoints; no full-cell SOC mapping is inferred.
